runs.design: Strict arm EXACTLY 4 distinct legal actions vs EXACTLY 8 distinct legal actions (first four of the same ordered eight); identical train and held-out both-pass-compatible worlds. First eligible >=8 legal both-pass state per seat/mix. Separate side-only paired single-tile placements at first both-pass state per every fifth seed, max one per deal, two actions compared on identical worlds. No hidden hand leakage.
runs.limitations: Provisional four-side number-lock; block winner, loneZero, bust and 101-match scoring unvalidated. Selected states and small clusters; 4/8 candidate ordering nonrandom, not exhaustive 8+ legal. Fixed simple continuation bots, uniform conditional posterior ignores opponent choice likelihood; exploratory deal-cluster 95% normal intervals uncorrected. Same-end side differences may reflect tie-break/side-label artifacts. Evaluation oracle regret optimistic; finish-first != match victory.
runs.nextAction: Repeat strict 4-vs-8 with more independent eligible deal clusters, then stratify side alternatives by different-end vs same-end; authenticate branch locking and blocked-round winner.
